subject: Soteria Therapeutics — DPA redlines and SCCs: transfer impact & role alignment
messages:
From: Evelyn Torres <evelyn.torres@soteriatx.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Rivers <mark.rivers@soteriatx.com>, Harper & Kline <contracts@hklegals.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Soteria DPA redline (v2) + SCCs questions

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward. Our legal team has reviewed Redwood's standard DPA and produced a short set of redlines (attached). High-level asks:

- Clarify controller/processor roles where the Order Form references customer-managed private deployments (we flagged Section 2.1).
- SCCs: we need confirmation that the template SCCs you provided can be executed with our counsel's suggested mapping (see annotated PDF).
- Transfer impact addendum: given our EU pilot, we need an explicit fallback routing for EU-origin data in the event of US region maintenance windows.

Could you confirm who at Redwood will own evidence for KMS and subprocessor lists during onboarding? Our procurement team needs a timeline for the evidence bundle.

Attachments: Soteria_DPA_Redline_v2.docx; Soteria_SCCs_annotated.pdf

Appreciate a quick sync — is Thursday morning workable?

Best,
Evelyn Torres
Head of Operations
Soteria Therapeutics

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Torres <evelyn.torres@soteriatx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Soteria DPA redline (v2) + SCCs questions

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the packet and the clear summary. Looping in Ben (AE) and Laura (Legal lead) so we can coordinate redlines and evidence.

Quick answers up front:
- Roles: we can accept customer controller / Redwood processor mapping for private deploys with a short definition tweak in Section 2.1; Laura can propose exact language.
- SCCs: Harper & Kline's mapping looks mostly compatible; legal will confirm one exception re: subprocessors and onward transfers.
- Fallback routing for EU: operationally feasible — we need to align SLA/edit to the Order Form to reflect covered maintenance windows.

Next steps I propose:
1) Laura to provide marked-up DPA text (redline) for the two role sentences.
2) Ben to capture procurement timeline and attach the Order Form draft we use internally.
3) Quick 30-min call Thursday 9:30–10:00 PT to walk the redlines and confirm evidence list.

If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Accounts — Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0192

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Harper & Kline <contracts@hklegals.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Soteria DPA redline (v2) + SCCs questions

Evelyn / team — thanks for the annotated SCCs, that was helpful. I reviewed the DPA redlines and attached a short, targeted markup. Summary of proposed compromise:

1) Roles (Section 2.1): Insert parenthetical clarifying language: "For customer-managed private deployments (as defined in the Order Form), the parties agree controller/processor responsibilities shall be allocated as set out in Exhibit A — with Redwood remaining processor for model inference and customer retaining controller status for customer-provided data."

2) SCCs: We can adopt Harper & Kline's mapping subject to a confirmation item: Redwood needs to reserve the right to update the subprocessor list with 30 days' notice; for critical changes we will provide immediate notification and mitigation steps.

3) Transfer impact / fallback routing: Add Order Form clause for "failed-region fallback" limited to maintenance or emergency events; Redwood will document the expected blackout windows per quarter and list available regions. Commercial offset (small credit) can be discussed if the fallback materially affects latency or cost.

I've included inline edits in the attached: Soteria_DPA_Redline_v2_marked.docx (sent back as PDF excerpt in this thread). If Soteria is comfortable with the wording above, Redwood can produce a final DPA + Order Form bundle for signature.

Proposed Thursday call confirmed — I will be on the call to walk legal points.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Soteria DPA redline (v2) + SCCs questions — quick confirmation

Laura / Stephanie / Ben — thanks for the fast turnaround and the markup. We reviewed internally and Soteria is comfortable with the three items you outlined, subject to two follow-ups before signature:

A) The fallback routing clause: can we add a 72-hour maximum notification window for planned maintenance that would trigger fallback? If not, we'll need the SLA credit language expanded.

B) Evidence timing: procurement asks for KMS attestation and subprocessor list within 10 business days of Order Form signature. Can Redwood commit to that timeline for the EU pilot?

If you confirm A and B in writing we can move to final signatures — we will circulate the DocuSign package once confirmed.

Thanks — happy to chat on Monday if needed.

Best,
Mark Rivers
VP Partnerships & Ops
Soteria Therapeutics
